name: get_file_content
description: Get file content as plain text by default. Set with_metadata=true for binary files, or when you need the SHA/encoding/links from the full ContentsResponse (e.g. before a follow-up update_file call). Optional start_line and end_line request a 1-indexed inclusive line range; out-of-range values clamp to the file extent. Range parameters are ignored when with_metadata=true.

params.name: with_metadata
params.desc: Return the full ContentsResponse (sha, encoding, links, type, size, base64 content) instead of plain text.

params.name: start_line
params.desc: Optional 1-indexed first line of the slice (inclusive). Defaults to 1 when only end_line is set.

params.name: end_line
params.desc: Optional 1-indexed last line of the slice (inclusive). Defaults to the file's last line when only start_line is set.

name: list_repo_commits
description: List commits, newest first, starting from sha (a branch, tag or commit; defaults to the default branch). Set path to a file or directory to get only the commits that touched it: file-scoped history shows who changed a file recently and how often, which tells you how much scrutiny a change there deserves.

params.name: path
params.desc: Optional file or directory path. Only commits that touched it are returned.

params.name: sha
params.desc: Branch, tag or commit SHA to start from (default: the default branch)

name: get_commit_diff
description: Get the unified diff of a single commit (its changes against its first parent). Pass an optional file_path to receive only the hunks for that file (match is exact on either the pre- or post-rename path). Pair with list_pr_commits to review a pull request commit by commit instead of only its squashed diff.

params.name: file_path
params.desc: Optional. Return only the diff section for this file (matched on the diff --git boundary). Omit for the full diff.

name: compare_refs
description: Compare two refs (branches, tags or commit SHAs) as base...head: the commits reachable from head but not from base (newest first), and the files those commits touched with their status. No pull request is needed, so use it to preview a PR before it exists, to check what actually landed between two releases or deploys, or to measure how far two branches have diverged. For the hunks themselves use get_commit_diff on the listed commits.

params.name: base
params.desc: Base ref (branch, tag or commit SHA)

params.name: head
params.desc: Head ref (branch, tag or commit SHA); the result is what head has that base does not

name: list_repo_contents
description: List the files and directories at a given path in a repository. Use path="" to list the repository root. Returns one level of entries at the specified path; for a full recursive file tree use get_repo_tree with recursive=true.

params.name: path
params.desc: Directory path within the repository (empty string lists the repository root)

name: get_repo_tree
description: Get the Git tree of a repository. With recursive=true, returns the complete file tree in a single response (subject to the server's tree-endpoint size cap); use this when you need all paths at once. With recursive=false (default), returns only the top-level entries of the tree.

params.name: recursive
params.desc: Return the complete file tree in one response (subject to server cap); default false returns top-level entries only

params.name: assignee
params.desc: Assignee username (convenience for a single user; equivalent to a one-element 'assignees')

params.name: assignees
params.desc: Assignee usernames (comma-separated). Overrides 'assignee' if both are set. Pass an empty string to clear all assignees.

name: list_issue_comments
description: List issue/PR comments. Returns all comments; the API does not support pagination for this endpoint.

name: list_repo_labels
description: List repository labels. When the owner is an organization and include_org_labels is true (default), org-level labels are merged into the response. Each label carries a scope field of "repo" or "org".

params.name: include_org_labels
params.desc: Merge org-level labels into the response when the owner is an organization. Default true.

name: create_label
description: Create a label on a repository or organization

params.name: repo
params.desc: Repository name. Omit to create an org-level label.

params.name: exclusive
params.desc: Whether this label is exclusive (only one label with the same scope can be applied)

name: edit_label
description: Edit a label on a repository or organization

params.name: repo
params.desc: Repository name. Omit to edit an org-level label.

name: delete_label
description: Delete a label from a repository or organization

params.name: repo
params.desc: Repository name. Omit to delete an org-level label.

name: list_pull_reviews
description: List reviews for a pull request

name: get_pull_review
description: Get a specific pull request review

name: list_pull_review_comments
description: List comments on a pull request review

params.name: force_merge
params.desc: Force merge even if checks have not passed

params.name: merge_when_checks_succeed
params.desc: Schedule merge for when all checks succeed

name: list_pull_request_files
description: List changed files in a pull request

name: get_pull_request_diff
description: Get the unified diff of a pull request. Pass an optional file_path to receive only the hunks for that file (match is exact on either the pre- or post-rename path). Use list_pull_request_files first to discover the file paths in the PR.

params.name: file_path
params.desc: Optional. Return only the diff section for this file (matched on the diff --git boundary). Omit for the full diff.

name: list_pr_commits
description: List the individual commits of a pull request, newest first, with SHA, message, author and date. Use it to review a PR commit by commit (pair with get_commit_diff), and to spot fixup commits, commits that do not belong, or changes introduced and then reverted within the PR, none of which are visible in the squashed diff.

name: create_pull_review
description: Create a pull request review with optional inline comments

params.name: comments
params.desc: Inline comments as JSON array, e.g. [{"path":"file.go","body":"Fix this","new_position":10}]

name: submit_pull_review
description: Submit a pending pull request review

name: delete_pull_review
description: Delete a pending pull request review

name: create_review_requests
description: Request reviews from specific users or teams

name: search
description: Search across all types (code, repos, issues, users, organizations). Returns hit counts and a preview of results for each type. Use search_code or search_repos for paginated results.

name: search_code
description: Search code across all accessible repositories

name: search_repos
description: Search repositories by name or description

name: dispatch_workflow
description: Trigger a workflow run. Returns the run ID.

params.name: ref
params.desc: Git ref to build (branch/tag). Defaults to repo default branch.

params.name: inputs
params.desc: Workflow inputs as JSON object, e.g. {"key": "value"}

name: list_workflow_runs
description: List workflow runs for a repository

params.name: status
params.desc: Filter by status (waiting, running, success, failure, cancelled)

name: get_workflow_run
description: Get details of a specific workflow run

name: get_job_logs
description: Get logs for a CI build run, grouped by job

params.name: job
params.desc: Filter logs to a specific job name

params.name: tail_lines
params.desc: Max log lines per job (default 200, max 500)

name: list_secrets
description: List repository Actions secret names (values are write-only and never returned)

name: set_secret
description: Create or update a repository Actions secret. Secrets are write-only: there is no get_secret tool because the value cannot be read back.

params.name: data
params.desc: Secret value. Write-only: there is no way to read it back once set.

name: list_org_secrets
description: List organization Actions secret names (values are write-only and never returned)

name: set_org_secret
description: Create or update an organization Actions secret. Secrets are write-only: there is no get_org_secret tool because the value cannot be read back.

params.name: data
params.desc: Secret value. Write-only: there is no way to read it back once set.

params.name: target_commitish
params.desc: Target branch or commit SHA (defaults to the repo default branch)

name: get_release_by_tag
description: Get a release by tag name

params.name: target
params.desc: Target branch or commit SHA (defaults to the repo default branch)
